lines: You must be the Crown's supplier. We heard you cleared Thornhaven's depths.
SproutRest needs you more. The spore corruption here is alive — it thinks, it adapts, it consumes.
Our Mossfolk are resilient, but resilience only delays the inevitable without proper supplies.
Your materials may be the difference between our survival and becoming part of the Mycelium.
The Crown sends a shopkeeper to fight corruption.
dialogs.notes: Voice only. Dismissive but now aware. Dry, almost amused.

lines: Shopkeeper. The Spiral Mycelium — defeated. Remarkable.
I confess, I did not expect you to survive that. His Majesty's faith in unconventional assets appears... well-placed.
The Sunken Strand requires attention next. Coastal corruption threatens vital trade routes.
Travel papers enclosed. The Crown watches your progress with great interest.
